sources.locator: "Dissolution of the Soviet Union", revision 1375840189, § lead

explanation: The English article on the dissolution says the Soviet Union was formally dissolved on 26 December 1991 and ceased to exist as a sovereign state, and that this ended Gorbachev’s efforts to reform the Soviet political and economic system. The record’s own retraction named the coup of August 1991 as the event it argued to, four months before the date the article gives.
